about-us.hero-description: We are volunteers united in supporting people and communities affected by emergencies in Colombia.
about-us.description: We created this website to amplify grassroots fundraisers that do not have access to support from larger organizations. We prioritize reviewed volunteers who are actively coordinating aid for affected families and communities.
about-us.onefaq.donation-impact.section1: While large organizations offer critical support, their ability to respond promptly to small groups across Colombia can be limited. Donations to grassroots groups help fill this gap.
about-us.onefaq.donation-impact.section2: Even a small donation towards urgent aid needs will have a major impact on someone’s life and their chance to survive.
about-us.onefaq.donation-impact.section3: Our goal is to direct support to people and communities in Colombia.
about-us.onefaq.credibility.section1: Typically, fundraisers demonstrate their credibility through extreme transparency (financial statements, photo evidence of receipts, supplies purchase, delivery). Often this information cannot be made public in wartime.
about-us.onefaq.credibility.section2: We help small fundraisers communicate their credibility without revealing sensitive information. All they need is someone with a credible social media reputation to vouch for their efforts. Read more:
about-us.onefaq.language-barrier.section: Donors want to know how their money will be spent and see some evidence of past volunteering activity. We help grassroots groups formulate and translate their fundraiser descriptions in English.
about-us.get-in-touch.heading: Get in touch
about-us.get-in-touch.description.sectio: Our project brings together volunteers with experience in design, development, law, cybersecurity, and community organizing. Anyone with the skills and capacity to help can join our efforts!
Use this form to get in touch about joining our volunteer group, partnerships, and media coverage.
